title: The Breaking Adversity Pill
summary: Xiao Yan returns to Hai Bodong with the Sand's Datura and refines the sixth-tier Breaking Adversity Pill for him in an ice chamber under the desert, with Yao Lao doing the refining and Xiao Yan watching. Yao Lao hides a cube of Bone Chilling Flame ice in the pill to protect them. Hai Bodong takes the pill, his seal breaks, and he is a Dou Huang again. He thinks about turning on Xiao Yan, then decides to stay friends and hands over the fragmented map. In Rock Desert City, Mo Ran, a One-Star Da Dou Shi sent by the Mo Clan of Yan City, beats Xiao Li and Xiao Ding. Xiao Yan arrives and fights Mo Ran himself, without Yao Lao's help.
events: Xiao Yan gives Hai Bodong the Sand's Datura and agrees to refine the pill first.
In a sealed ice chamber, Yao Lao refines the Breaking Adversity Pill with the cauldron Black Demon while Xiao Yan watches.
Yao Lao hides Bone Chilling Flame ice in the pill as a safeguard.
Hai Bodong takes the pill and breaks his seal, becoming a Dou Huang again.
Hai Bodong gives Xiao Yan the fragmented map.
Mo Ran beats Xiao Li and Xiao Ding at the Desert Metal compound.
Xiao Yan arrives and fights Mo Ran alone, and Mo Ran shows his Dou Qi Armor.
